policies.title: PM-AJAY (Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana) - Grants-in-Aid (GIA) Component Operational Guidelines
policies.authority: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (MoSJE), Government of India
policies.summary: PM-AJAY was formed by merging three erstwhile central sector schemes: Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAGY), Special Central Assistance to Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SCA to SCSP), and Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana (BJRCY). The Grants-in-Aid (GIA) component specifically targets comprehensive socio-economic development of SC communities through skill development, infrastructure creation, and direct income-generating schemes.
key_provisions_sc: 100% grant assistance for market-driven NSQF skill development training courses for SC youth with mandatory placement tracking.
Monthly stipend of ₹1,500/month for day scholars and complete residential boarding for residential trainees.
Tool-kit financial assistance up to ₹10,000 - ₹15,000 provided in-kind or via DBT upon successful qualification.
Credit linkage facilitation through State Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporations (DSFDC in Delhi) with capital subsidies up to ₹50,000 or 50% of project cost.
Targeted convergence with Common Service Centres (CSC), Jan Shikshan Sansthans (JSS), and District Employment Exchanges.
policies.notes: Statutory policy guidelines excerpt; requires periodic review against official gazette notifications.

policies.title: National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) & National Credit Framework (NCrF) Gazette Regulations
policies.authority: National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET) & Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
policies.summary: The National Skills Qualifications Framework organizes qualifications into a series of levels of knowledge, skills, and aptitude from Level 1 to Level 8. It enables vertical and horizontal mobility between technical/vocational education and general academic streams under NEP 2020 through the National Credit Framework.
key_provisions_sc: Clear progression pathways from uncertified/informal work (RPL - Recognition of Prior Learning) to Level 3, Level 4 (independent technician), and Level 5+ (supervisor/entrepreneur).
Mandatory competency-based assessment and independent certification by Sector Skill Councils (SSCs) or NCVT.
Credit accumulation and transfer via the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) / Skill India Digital Portal.
Standardized minimum wages linked to NSQF qualification levels in government procurement and private industry.
policies.notes: Statutory policy guidelines excerpt; requires periodic review against official gazette notifications.

policies.title: Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (SCSP) Strategy & Delhi State Welfare Directives
policies.authority: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Government of NCT of Delhi
policies.summary: Mandates that plan funds proportional to the SC population of NCT of Delhi (approx 16.75% as per Census) must be exclusively allocated and spent on targeted welfare, educational scholarships, modern skilling, and self-employment promotion for Scheduled Caste residents.
key_provisions_sc: Zero tuition fees for SC students across all government ITIs, polytechnics, and DSEU community colleges in Delhi.
Special corpus funds allocated to DSFDC for low-interest micro-credit (Dilli Swarojgar Yojna).
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) integration with Aadhaar-linked Public Financial Management System (PFMS) to eliminate intermediaries.
Priority commercial booth / shop allotment for SC entrepreneurs in Delhi DDA and MCD commercial markets.
policies.notes: Statutory policy guidelines excerpt; requires periodic review against official gazette notifications.

policies.title: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Stand-Up India & NSFDC Concessional Lending Norms
policies.authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance / National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC)
policies.summary: Establishes institutional credit access for SC, ST, and Women borrowers for greenfield enterprise setup between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore. Collateral risk is backed by the Credit Guarantee Fund for Stand-Up India (CGFSI).
key_provisions_sc: Mandates every scheduled commercial bank branch across Delhi NCR to extend at least one loan to an SC/ST borrower.
Margin money requirement reduced from 25% down to 15% with convergence from state subsidy schemes.
No third-party collateral required up to the loan ceiling, covered by NCGTC guarantee.
Direct technical and financial handholding provided through SIDBI Stand-Up Mitra centers and lead district managers.
policies.notes: Statutory policy guidelines excerpt; requires periodic review against official gazette notifications.

policies.title: Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University Act & Livelihood Incubation Policy
policies.authority: Legislative Assembly of National Capital Territory of Delhi
policies.summary: Established DSEU to deliver world-class skill education, bridge industry-academia divide, and nurture entrepreneurial mindset specifically focusing on socio-economically marginalized youth in Delhi.
key_provisions_sc: Dual vocational model with 50% classroom learning and 50% paid on-the-job training (OJT) in Delhi industrial clusters.
Reserved seats and 100% financial assistance for low-income SC trainees.
Incubation support, seed funding, and business mentorship for graduates starting self-employment ventures.
Apprenticeship contracts under NAPS (National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme) with monthly stipends.
policies.notes: Statutory policy guidelines excerpt; requires periodic review against official gazette notifications.

policies.title: National Career Service (NCS) Mission & Model Career Centre Framework
policies.authority: Ministry of Labour & Employment (MoLE), Government of India
policies.summary: Transformation of traditional National Employment Exchanges into digital, counseling-driven Model Career Centers (MCC). Provides nationwide job matching, local hiring drives, career aptitude testing, and vocational guidance.
key_provisions_sc: Free registration and priority career counseling for SC/ST job seekers at Delhi Model Career Centers.
Organized Rozgar Melas (job fairs) in Delhi industrial hubs (Okhla, Mayapuri, Narela, Patparganj) with on-the-spot interviews.
Integration of Aadhaar, DigiLocker, and Skill India credentials to verify qualifications instantly.
Specialized modules on soft skills, digital literacy, and interview preparation for first-generation job seekers.
policies.notes: Statutory policy guidelines excerpt; requires periodic review against official gazette notifications.
